forbidden_redistribution: No fork jar, classes or assets may be bundled, shaded, hosted, re-uploaded, committed, or shipped in anything this project distributes.
No Flashback implementation may be copied into project source.
User ownership of the fork is not evidence of permission to redistribute the upstream-derived portions.
permitted_local_use: Cloning, building and running the fork locally for validation is permitted; that is what this worker did.

An E2E request authorises setting up the fork as a local test dependency: the locally built artifact may be copied into a project-isolated, gitignored test instance (for example under run/ or .upstream/) so the run is self-contained.
The fork may therefore be an ignored local test-only dependency; it must never be a shipped or committed one.
binding_constraints_for_project.practical_rule: Nothing derived from the fork enters git or a distributable path, and the mod plus its tests must still work with Flashback absent.
binding_constraints_for_project.withdrawn_claim: An earlier revision of docs/FLASHBACK_COMPATIBILITY.md invented a requirement that the user install the fork by hand into their own launcher profile and treated the licence as a blocker for local testing. That was wrong: the restriction is on redistribution, not on local use, and the claim is withdrawn.

license.requires_parent_decision: Record the non-redistribution rule and the permitted project-isolated local test setup. This is a documentation/process decision, not a technical blocker.

headless_checks.harness_status: REWRITTEN after parent review. The earlier logs/run-fork-checks.ps1 is superseded: it could report PASS when a tool never launched, and it built its classpath by scanning all of ~/.gradle (which picked Gson 2.10.1 over 2.14.0 and swallowed copy failures).
headless_checks.harness_reason: The fork's devtools/checks/run.sh and run-replay-inventory.sh assume macOS/Library paths and bash, so a Windows port is required. The fork checkout is not modified.

invocation_audit_trail.purpose: Every invocation's full stdout and stderr plus a one-line header with the real exit code and whether the process started. This is the evidence for a passing run, because the console only shows the one-line summary.

classpath_provenance.method: Gradle init script dumps the fork's own resolved runtimeClasspath and compileClasspath by absolute path; no scanning of ~/.gradle and no copy step.
classpath_provenance.why_both: runtimeClasspath is what the mod actually loads; compileClasspath additionally carries the compileOnly compat mods whose classes Flashback's compat mixins and the fork's source checks reference. Behaviour suites run against runtimeClasspath; compile and source checks use the combined set.
classpath_provenance.starlight_evidence: ca.spottedleaf.starlight.common.light.SWMRNibbleArray is not in runtimeClasspath nor anywhere in ~/.gradle as its own jar; it is bundled inside maven.modrinth:scalablelux (a compileOnly dependency). Without compileClasspath, ContainerGuiCheck fails with NoClassDefFoundError on that class.
classpath_provenance.gson_resolved: com.google.code.gson:gson:2.14.0 (Minecraft 26.3 requires >= 2.11). The old harness's first-match scan selected 2.10.1 and failed ContainerWireTest.

safety_properties: Tool paths are validated with Test-Path before use; a missing tool throws and the process exits non-zero.

Start-Process is used instead of the call operator because $LASTEXITCODE is not reliably set for .bat/.cmd wrappers (gradlew.bat) and PowerShell reuses the previous value when a command fails to start. Start-Process reports the real exit code in .ExitCode.
A null exit code means 'the process never ran' and is reported as INVALID, never PASS. Any INVALID makes the run exit non-zero.
Arguments containing whitespace are quoted explicitly: Start-Process does not quote for the caller, and an unquoted path with spaces is split by the command line parser.
The scratch directory path is resolved and asserted to be a descendant of the project root before Remove-Item is allowed to delete it.
Suite invocations run with the fork as the working directory, asserted there, because several suites open relative paths such as 'src/main/java/...' and 'build/classes/java/main/...'.
Classpath entries are all verified to exist; the previous design copied jars and swallowed failures.
The Gradle classpath-dump log is ignored output kept for diagnosis; it is not allowed to decide the result.

replay_format_contract.finding: The fork introduces NO new action type and NO new serialized field in the replay container format.
replay_format_contract.method: SHA-256 comparison of every file in src/main/java/com/moulberry/flashback/action/ between .upstream/flashback (bf046b7) and .upstream/flashback-j-w-i. All 11 files are byte-identical.

format_shape.layout: magic int; varint action count; that many action names as identifiers; int snapshotSize; snapshot bytes; action stream
format_shape.action_lookup: file-local index -> Action, built from the written names
format_shape.unknown_action_behaviour: On load, an action name that is not registered throws RuntimeException('Missing action: ' + name) UNLESS the name path ends with 'optional', in which case it is recorded in ignoredActions and skipped.
format_shape.consequence: Adding a new Action would change the file format and be rejected by an older build. The fork added none, so a stock 0.43.6 reader can still parse the action list; the fork's container/GUI additions ride as ordinary game packets inside flashback:action/game_packet.

new_payloads_written_into_recordings.id: flashback:remote_container (Flashback.createIdentifier inferred from packet class TYPE)

order_of_operations: 1. GuiRecording.observePacket(packet) runs BEFORE any filtering (line 876) so the mirror captures what the client is about to have, i.e. client-side prediction the server never echoes.
3. ClientboundCustomPayloadPacket whose type id namespace starts with 'fabric-screen-handler-api' is dropped (lines 890-894).
5. ClientboundSetEntityDataPacket and ClientboundSetEquipmentPacket for Minecraft.getInstance().player are dropped (lines 900-911) because the replay server owns the recorded player's state.

sets.IGNORED_IN_REPLAY: written but deliberately not applied at playback (stats, recipe book, advancements, dialogs, tracked waypoints, transfer)
sets.CONTAINER_PACKETS: written only when GuiPlayback.enabled() (config internal.showGuisInReplays); isIgnoredType checks this BEFORE IGNORED

ignored_packet_set.documented_hazard: A packet listed in both CONTAINER_PACKETS and IGNORED silently disables the whole container feature because IGNORED wins on the fall-through; the fork's own comment says so.

real_snapshot_contents.cadence: at the end of a chunk (Recorder.CHUNK_LENGTH_SECONDS = 5*60 = 300 s) and at finish; asActualSnapshot == true
includes: configuration block (enabled features, full registry data, tags, resource packs)

gated on config recording.recordHotbar: ClientboundSetExperiencePacket, ClientboundSetHealthPacket (health/food/saturation), ClientboundSetHeldSlotPacket, and all 9 hotbar slots as ClientboundContainerSetSlotPacket on container 0 (lines 1126-1146)

recording_contract.packet_allowlist_note_absent: There is no allowlist; recording is denylist-based, so a mod's unknown payloads are recorded by default unless configured out.

handle_game_packet.decode_failure: DecoderException is logged (bounded to 8 messages), pending entities are flushed, the buffer is skipped to the end of the packet, and decoding resumes. No abort.

custom_payload_path.purpose: Avoid reserialization because 'some mods are poorly written and the packet != encode(decode(packet))'.
steps: Reject if the payload id matches advanced.ignoredCustomPayloads (IgnoredCustomPayloads, namespace ':*' and '+' re-allow supported).
If the payload is a FlashbackRemoteContainer, notify GuiDisplayForwarder.observe(container).
Extract the raw bytes (rewind, skip the packet id varint) and wrap in FlashbackRawCustomPayload.
Send to every replay viewer via ServerPlayNetworking.send.

unsupported_packet_handling.mechanism: ReplayGamePacketHandler (and ReplayConfigurationPacketHandler) throw UnsupportedPacketException from ~50 handlers.
unsupported_packet_handling.note: These types are also in IgnoredPacketSet, so they should never appear in a fork recording. The throw is a guard, not the normal path. A payload type present in a recording but not ignorable is the failure mode to watch.

registry_tolerance.purpose: Tolerate registry mismatches during playback; relevant because a terrain/profile mod can shift registry contents between record and playback.

seek_and_state_restore.decision_point: playback/ReplayServer.java:1487-1518 handleActions() computes shouldJump (backwards, or forwards beyond the current chunk) and jumps to the floor snapshot

chunks.mechanism: replayChunkCache.getOrLoad(index, registryAccess, gamePacketCodec); skipped when the cached chunk id already matches; a miss logs 'Missing cached level chunk: {}'
chunks.no_generation: Chunks are replayed from the recording cache, not regenerated.

container_state_across_seek.mechanism: The open AbstractContainerScreen's id, kind, title, full item list and carried stack are written into the real snapshot by Recorder (lines 1222-1228); a MerchantMenu additionally writes its offers, trader level/xp/progress/restock because 'the offers packet is behind the snapshot and a seek never plays it again'. Per-tick deltas are written by GuiRecording.tick().

not_restored_by_clear_data: local player inventory/hotbar contents at seek time (covered by the snapshot writes when recordHotbar is enabled)
seek_and_state_restore.fork_self_assessment: devtools/checks/README.md: ReplayInventorySlotsTest 'exercises an open -> update -> close -> seek -> restore state sequence ... It is a headless model, not a substitute for recording and replaying in game.'

critical_default_mismatch.consequence: With defaults, container packets ARE written to a recording while the local player's XP/health/held slot/hotbar are NOT. Every E2E run must state both flags explicitly. An assumption that 'if containers are recorded the hotbar is too' is false.

ignored_custom_payloads.syntax: newline-separated; 'namespace:*' for a namespace; '+' prefix re-allows; bare identifier for one payload
ignored_custom_payloads.role: The sanctioned, user-visible, no-source-change way to keep a namespace's payloads out of replays.

e2e_matrix.name: Install and launch
e2e_matrix.preconditions: User installs merged-0.43.6.1.jar (SHA-256 F6DCC11FE132E55ACE33C67861A951BF2B77391F4E01B0300F74561FBDA6A51A) into a Fabric 26.3 / loader 0.19.5 profile with Java 25.
e2e_matrix.actions: Launch; open a singleplayer world; open the Flashback editor.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: Mod loads with no mixin apply failure in the log; editor opens.

e2e_matrix.name: Record then replay baseline
e2e_matrix.actions: Record at least 60 s including movement, block break and place, a container opened and closed, and rain (and snow if reachable); stop; play from the start.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: Recorded actions appear in order; terrain renders; the container reappears and closes; hotbar, XP, health and food match the session.

e2e_matrix.name: Seek fidelity
e2e_matrix.actions: Seek backwards past a container open/close; seek forwards beyond 300 s so a real snapshot boundary is crossed; seek to tick 1; seek repeatedly across the same boundary.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: Container is either correctly open with correct contents or correctly closed, never partial; no stale block-cracking overlay; hotbar/XP/health/food still correct; weather still animating; no exception and no 'Missing cached level chunk' in the log.

e2e_matrix.name: Weather fixes specifically
e2e_matrix.actions: In rain, move the camera slowly across several block boundaries including vertically, then seek mid-rain.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: No texture jump when crossing block boundaries; rain/snow continues across the seek.

e2e_matrix.name: Moderner Beta world: record and replay
e2e_matrix.preconditions: Moderner Beta installed and a historical preset world selected.
e2e_matrix.actions: Record in that world; replay; seek backwards and forwards. Then repeat with Moderner Beta removed from the playback profile.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: Replay shows the recorded terrain and does not attempt generation; no worldgen or registry exception; works with Moderner Beta present. The absent-mod result is recorded separately as an expected-to-differ outcome.

e2e_matrix.name: Replay does not execute server-authoritative gameplay
e2e_matrix.actions: During playback including while paused and after a seek, attempt any historical gameplay rule our mod enforces; inspect the replay server's world.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: No gameplay rule fires on the synthetic world; the replay world gains no persistent state; the recorded world on disk is unchanged (compare file hashes before and after).

e2e_matrix.name: Registry tolerance
e2e_matrix.actions: Record in a Moderner Beta world; change a registry-affecting aspect (mod version, preset, or biome set); replay.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: lenient_registry tolerates the mismatch, or it fails safely with a diagnosable log; never silently wrong terrain and never an unattributable crash.

e2e_matrix.name: Our mod's payloads through record and seek
e2e_matrix.actions: With our own payloads emitted, record; replay; seek across them; then re-run with our namespace added to advanced.ignoredCustomPayloads.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: With the ignore entry, our payloads are absent from the replay and nothing breaks; without it, presence/absence and ordering are recorded precisely so the behaviour is a decision rather than an accident.

e2e_matrix.name: Seek and state-restore negative paths
e2e_matrix.actions: Record a session that opens a merchant trade, a mount screen and the player inventory; seek into the middle of each.
e2e_matrix.pass_criteria: Each is reconstructed or absent, never partially applied; no item appears in a slot that cannot hold it.

parent_question_assessment.question: Historical screens/HUD profile synchronisation and seek safety; whether a dedicated recorded idempotent profile payload plus snapshot restoration is needed; server enforcement must not execute on the replay synthetic world; profile data must not require historical metadata on disk.
parent_question_assessment.answer: Feasible without changing the fork or its file format, because the mechanism already exists for containers and the profile family is already snapshot-anchored. Open items are measurement, not deduction.
supporting_findings: GuiRecording.snapshotState() plus Recorder.writeSnapshot(1222-1228) is exactly 'idempotent full-state payload written into the real snapshot', and GuiRecording.tick() is the per-tick delta channel. A profile payload should follow this shape.

Recorder already writes ClientboundSetExperiencePacket, ClientboundSetHealthPacket and ClientboundSetHeldSlotPacket plus all 9 hotbar slots into real snapshots (1126-1146), and ReplayGamePacketHandler.handleSetExperience/handleSetHealth apply them and re-broadcast to viewers. A seek therefore already restores XP, health, food and hotbar contents when recordHotbar=true.

Game mode is handled differently: ClientboundPlayerAbilitiesPacket is IGNORED and handlePlayerAbilities throws, so abilities are never recorded; game mode is read per-render from the spectated player's PlayerInfo.
Recorder drops the recording player's own ClientboundSetEntityDataPacket and ClientboundSetEquipmentPacket, so a profile design must not depend on those packets being present.

Every profile value is read from the live LocalPlayer's in-memory fields at record time; no fork path reads a world's saved data to render a HUD, so 'no historical metadata on disk' is satisfied by construction.

'Server enforcement must not run on the synthetic world' is a constraint on our code: MixinServerLevel's entity-spawn suppression and the generator stubs are Flashback's own guards and do not stop our server-side rules.
No new Action is needed; adding one would change the file format and be rejected by stock readers (ReplayReader throws on an unknown non-optional action).
open_measurements: Whether a second payload type is delivered at the same point as the fork's container payloads on every seek (they are delivered on join via PlayerList.sendLevelInfo and at snapshot application).
Whether internal.showGuisInReplays=false changes that delivery path for other payload types.
Whether the profile payload should be gated on recordHotbar or on its own flag.
parent_question_assessment.architecture_change: none proposed; parent stated no final architecture change yet, and none is required by these findings
